description: This file contains functions related to merging Git trees and commits using the 'ort' algorithm. It includes implementations for non-recursive and recursive merges, handling merge result processing, and utilities for referencing commits and handling repository state.

methods.name: int unclean(struct merge_options * opt,struct tree * head)
methods.description: Checks if the repository has uncommitted local changes that would be overwritten by a merge. Returns -1 if there are changes, 0 otherwise.

methods.name: struct:commit * get_ref(struct repository * repo,const struct object_id * oid,const char * name)
methods.description: Resolves a reference to a commit, handling tags and virtual commits. Returns a commit pointer or NULL if resolution fails.

int merge_ort_recursive(struct merge_options * opt,struct commit * side1,struct commit * side2,const struct commit_list * merge_bases,struct commit ** result)
